title: zh-CN: a person's display name is composed "first last" (「大雷 王」), where Chinese order is family name first with no space (「王大雷」)
body:
## What happens

On @objectstack 18.5.0, a zh-CN organization in the downstream carbon-black CRM (steedos-labs/os-project-blackcat-crm) has a contact with first_name 大雷 and last_name 王. Its name renders as 「大雷 王」:
- in the record page lookup;
- in the printed quote document (service-print), field 联系人.

A Chinese reader expects 「王大雷」: family name first, no separator.

## Ask

Compose a person's display name by locale, or by script: for zh, ja and ko, `last + first` with no space; otherwise `first + " " + last`. This applies wherever the platform builds the name from first and last parts: the lookup display, print, and list cells. If the composition is metadata (a formula `name` field on the object), say so, and the downstream app will adjust its own formula. In that case, a platform helper or documented pattern for locale-aware name order would still help every app.

Dedupe words: Chinese name order, family name first, display name first last zh-CN, contact name 王大雷.
